genealogy: restart api (detached 8080)
args: $root = "C:\Users\akortekaas\Documents\GitHub\TaliesinDS.github.io"; $apiDir = Join-Path $root "genealogy\api"; $py = Join-Path $root ".venv\Scripts\python.exe"; if (-not (Test-Path $py)) { throw "Missing venv python: $py" }; $env:DATABASE_URL = "postgresql://postgres:polini@localhost:5432/genealogy"; $conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if ($conn -and $conn.OwningProcess -gt 0) { Stop-Process -Id $conn.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $stamp = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"; $reports = Join-Path $root "reports"; if (-not (Test-Path $reports)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $reports | Out-Null }; $outLog = Join-Path $reports ("uvicorn_" + $stamp + ".out.log"); $errLog = Join-Path $reports ("uvicorn_" + $stamp + ".err.log"); Start-Process -FilePath $py -WorkingDirectory $apiDir -ArgumentList @("-m","uvicorn","main:app","--host","127.0.0.1","--port","8080") -RedirectStandardOutput $outLog -RedirectStandardError $errLog -WindowStyle Hidden; "Restarted API. Logs: $outLog / $errLog"

tasks.label: genealogy: verify neighborhood has given/surname
args: $url = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080/graph/neighborhood?id=I0001&depth=1&layout=family'; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url | Select-Object -ExpandProperty nodes | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'person' -and $_.display_name -ne 'Private' } | Select-Object -First 1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
